scoring_justification: The task requires re-running DFT calculations; the verifier sandbox cannot recompute from logs, so the agent's reported final values are compared to the paper's reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for VEA and Gibbs free energies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (VEA) and Table 2 (Gibbs at 400 K)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper: VEA_OAA=0.20 eV (cis-enol), VEA_CA=-1.52 eV; Gibbs_M_H_OAA=0.19 eV, Gibbs_M_H_CA=0.17 eV, Gibbs_M_HCOOH_OAA=-0.73 eV, Gibbs_M_HCOOH_CA=-0.80 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published computational results for the identical level of theory requested in the task; they are the natural hidden gold.

outputs.description: Computed vertical electron affinities and Gibbs free energies (400 K) for the dehydrogenation and formic acid loss channels of oxaloacetic and citric acids.

output_contract.notes: All values are in eV. The Gibbs free energies correspond to the reactions M + e⁻ → [M-H]⁻ + H and M + e⁻ → [M-HCOOH]⁻ + HCOOH at 400 K. The agent must compute these using the specified density functional and basis set.
